title: Smart Data Models - Catena-X - SingleLevelBomAsPlanned
description:
The single-level bill of material (BoM) represents one sub-level of an assembly and does not include any lower-level subassemblies. In the As-Planned lifecycle state all variants are covered ("120% BoM").
If multiple versions of child parts exist that can be assembled into the same parent part, all versions of the child part are included in the BoM.
If there are multiple suppliers for the same child part, each supplier has an entry for their child part in the BoM. (Catena-X aspect model urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_bom_as_planned:4.0.0#SingleLevelBomAsPlanned, translated from the SAMM-generated JSON Schema; aspect property names and nested structures are kept verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Built as urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<UUID of the Catena-X digital twin (globalAssetId without the urn:uuid: prefix)>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SingleLevelBomAsPlanned'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

childItems.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.industry_core.single_level_bom_as_planned:4.0.0#childItems'. Set of child items in As-Planned lifecycle phase, of which the given parent object is assembled by (one structural level down).

items.description: globalAssetId and meta data of the assembled child item.

quantity.description: Quantity of which the child part will be assembled into the parent part.

value.description: The quantity value associated with the unit.

unit.description: The unit of an item. Common units may be related to mass, count, linear, area, volume or misc.

globalAssetId.description: The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.

lastModifiedOn.description: Timestamp when the assembly or usage relationship between parent part and child part was last modified.

createdOn.description: Timestamp when the relation between the parent part and the child part was created

validityPeriod.description:
The period of time during which the parent-child relation is valid. This relates to whether a child part can be built into or used in the production of the parent part at a given time.
If no validity period is given the relation is considered valid at any point in time.

validFrom.description: Start date and time of validity period.

businessPartner.description: The supplier of the given child item.

globalAssetId.description: Property. Model:'urn:samm:io.catenax.shared.industry_core.common:1.0.0#globalAssetId'. The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
